newsitem.title: USA: GOLF-WOODS TAKES QUAD CITY LEAD.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-WOODS TAKES QUAD CITY LEAD.

text.p: battling to secure an exemption for 1997, fired a 6-under-par
64 to take a one-stroke lead after two rounds of the $1.2
million Quad City Classic at the Oakwood Country Club Friday.
Woods is at 7-under 133, one stroke better than Ed Fiori,
who carded a 68. Joel Edwards and Jeff Maggert are two strokes
back at 5-under 135. Four players, including U.S. Open
champion Steve Jones, are at 4-under 136. Jones recorded his
Woods had nine birdies and three bogeys in his 10th round
as a professional. Woods, who tied for 11th at last week's
Canadian Open, is in his third tournament since turning
professional following an unprecedented third straight U.S.
Amateur Championship. Woods entered this tournament 204th on
